title: Extend unadmitted reporting coverage at inline fanout and workspace compatibility boundaries
outcome: Add producer-boundary tests for fewer than 16, exactly 16 and 17 checks, and same-binding incompatible-workspace baseline handling; strengthen negative asynchronous assertions with completion barriers.

A same-binding workspace change uses assumed_missing_baseline, retaining truthful observation timestamps, and negative send/retry assertions wait for an authoritative worker completion barrier.
The maintained full gate passes on the exact input.
